# TrainLens 0.19.1 — Agent safety and monitoring reliability

A backwards-compatible maintenance release for the Python-first TrainLens package.

## Agent Mode safety and context guarantees

- Sanitize portable-run parameters, notes, model names and run identifiers before exposing them as citable evidence to external coding agents.
- Use percent-encoded parameter evidence IDs to distinguish names such as `learning rate` and `learning_rate`.
- Keep the generated agent Markdown within `ContextPolicy.max_chars`; with very small budgets, compact evidence sections only contain actually visible evidence IDs. Output schema and instructions remain available through structured `AgentContext` fields.
- Ensure dataset-context truncation never overflows the configured character budget.

## Monitoring performance

- Avoid creating a full immutable copy of the training-observation history on each monitor step when only built-in detectors are configured.
- Custom detectors continue receiving the same complete immutable history snapshot.

## Compatibility and tests

- Public Python analysis, notebook, plotting, PDF, CLI and Agent Mode APIs remain available.
- Add regression tests covering privacy, evidence ID uniqueness, character-budget edge cases and monitor history copying.
- The source remains pure Python: native Rust acceleration is **not** part of this release.

Upgrade with `pip install --upgrade trainlens==0.19.1`.
